lead: The searches a person keeps under a name: a row of them to choose from (and remove), and a button that asks for a name and keeps the current search. It stores nothing and knows nothing of what a view holds: `views` are given, and `onSelect`, `onDelete` and `onSave` hand every change back to you, so the views can live in the browser, in a store or on the server. It goes above a table, next to [Table Toolbar](/table-toolbar).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: A view is `{ id, name }` and whatever else you keep in it: here a keyword. Type something to search and the button turns on; pressing a view puts its keyword back.
usage.placeholder: Type a keyword, then save it as a view…
usage.hint: Where the views are kept is the page's business: this demo keeps them in memory.

storage.title: Saving somewhere slow
storage.description: `onSave` may return a promise: the dialog shows it working, closes when it is done, and stays open when it fails (show the error yourself).

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: SavedViews is Button + Dialog + Input and has no slot of its own.
